message:
Before you go, let's come back to right now. Feel your feet on the floor and your back against the chair. Look around and name five things you can see, then take one slow breath. Whatever you wrote about is in the past; this moment is where you are.

Aap abhi yahan hain, is waqt mein — ek gehri saans lein.
